Contact

Write to us

A question, an idea, a partnership, a press request — or something that worries you in a game? We read everything.

hello@ludea.ai

A problem in a game for children

If something in a game of the catalogue seems unsuitable or unsafe for children, write to us with the game's name and what you saw. It is our first priority: the game is taken offline while we check.

A game that uses the name Ludea

Games made with the Ludea engine may say « made with Ludea », even when Ludea does not publish them. Only the games of the catalogue have been reviewed by Ludea. If a game outside the catalogue uses the name Ludea and seems harmful — to children above all — write to us with its address: we ask its creator to remove the mention, and report it to its host when needed.

You made a game

From your game's Claude Code session: /idea sends an idea or a problem to the engine team, /publish asks for your game to join the catalogue (or sends an update). To remove your game from the catalogue, just write to us.

Developers

Everything is open source on GitHub. Engine bugs and ideas: ludea-ai/game-engine (issues are public — no personal information there, please).
